notes_zh: 2711 编辑器统一生图 Prompt 模板。Agent 用 build-prompt 子命令或本文件直接拼装，禁止每次手写风格词。
base_negative: NOT photorealistic, NOT photography, NOT live action, NOT 3D render, NOT CGI, NOT Unreal Engine, NOT hyperrealistic, NOT stock photo, watermark, text overlay, blurry, low detail

scene.zh: 游戏场景纯背景（无 UI）
scene.prompt_pattern: {subject}, {style_prefix}, wide visual novel background, Chinese everyday or historical context as appropriate, {crowd_suffix}

landing.zh: 落地页 Hero / Feature 大图
landing.prompt_pattern: {subject}, {landing_prefix}, fantasy game UI design, parchment scroll, floating island castle, magical gears crystals feathers, soft diffused light, hand-drawn illustration

ui.zh: 界面装饰插画（可含 UI 语境）
ui.prompt_pattern: {subject}, {ui_prefix}, 2D anime art style, Studio Ghibli style, watercolor background, pastel blue pink mint green, ethereal lighting, healing cozy atmosphere, hand-drawn illustration

icon.zh: 小图标 / 贴纸（需透明底）
icon.bg_prompt_suffix: , isolated object centered on pure flat white background, generous white margins, sticker cutout style, no shadow, single subject only
icon.prompt_pattern: {subject}, 2D anime art style, Japanese animation, Studio Ghibli style, watercolor painted texture, pastel soft blue pale pink mint green, ethereal lighting, healing cozy atmosphere, fantasy game UI accent, hand-drawn illustration, NOT 3D{bg_suffix}
icon.negative_append: {negative}, busy background, scenery, landscape, multiple objects

workbench.zh: 工坊 / 控制台面板图
workbench.prompt_pattern: {subject}, {ui_prefix}, visual novel editor workbench panel, parchment paper texture, ornate metallic borders, 2D anime illustration, pastel healing palette

game_scene.wire: frontend/js/scene-images.js SCENES 映射 + manifest scenes

workshop_empty.subject_en: magical open story scroll with tiny floating feathers and soft glowing crystals, upload motif

hero.subject_en: visual novel editor landing hero, open scroll with branching story paths, floating UI panels over castle island
